description: Each service line uses its catalog standard unit price. Services are not taxable.
Each product line uses its catalog standard unit price. Products use the fictional tax rule.
Fictional tax rate on products only; not a statement of Texas law.
Round monetary amounts to two decimal places.
Fixed amount, only when the visit notes document authorization. Applies to service charges before tax. At most one discount per invoice.
Only for a Senior wellness visit for a cat aged 10 or older, with EX-105 billed and authorization documented in the visit notes. Applies to service charges before tax. Not combined with B-06.
Product tax is based on undiscounted products; discounts apply to service charges only.
A repeated code is not automatically an error; it is a duplicate only when the notes establish fewer occurrences than billed.
Temperance flags and explains; it cannot finalize corrections.

rule_value: Billing must agree with visit notes
description: A charge for a service the notes record as declined, canceled, not administered, or performed fewer times than billed is a discrepancy.
Each billed code must be in the catalog with its catalog description. A mismatched description is a discrepancy; an unknown code requires staff review.
Pending, unsigned, or unclear documentation for a billed service requires staff review. A billed service the notes do not mention is not, by itself, a documentation problem.
